worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 8,000.00 = 8,000.00. Federal taxable income = 8,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 0.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form PIT-RES (filing status 1 single, Column B): Line 1 federal AGI 8,000.00; Line 2 other states' obligations interest 0.00; Line 3 0.00; Line 4 total 8,000.00. Line 5 U.S. obligations interest 0.00. Line 6 pension exclusion 0.00. Line 7 0.00; Line 8a 0.00; Line 8b 0.00. Line 9 (Lines 5-8b) = 0.00. Line 10 = 8,000.00 - 0.00 = 8,000.00. Line 11 0.00 (Line 11 worksheet: under 60 and not disabled). Line 12 Delaware AGI = 8,000.00. Line 20a standard deduction (filing status 1) 3,250.00; Line 21 additional standard deduction 0 box(es) for 65 or over x 2,500.00 = 0.00; Line 22 = 3,250.00. Line 23 taxable income = 8,000.00 - 3,250.00 = 4,750.00. Line 24 tax, §1102(a)(14) schedule as numbers: 2.2% x 2,750.00 = 60.50; total 60.50 (the Division's tax table, not in the sources, would give a row figure; expected keeps the formula). Line 25 0.00; Line 26 = 60.50. Line 27a personal credits 1 x 110.00 = 110.00; Line 27b additional credits 0 box(es) for 60 or over x 110.00 = 0.00; Line 32 total non-refundable credits 110.00. Line 33 balance = 60.50 - 110.00, below zero, so 0.00 (credits are non-refundable: 60.50 of the 110.00 is used; expected credits shows the amount used).
